messages:
claire: Noticing intermittent ptls failures and increased handshake latency in eu-central after last night's cert bundle rotation. Customers saw a few 502s. Anyone oncall?

omar: I'm on it. Which services are failing?

claire: svc-ingest -> svc-normalizer and some egress proxies. Traces show clients aborting after ~700ms handshake.

jin: Can you paste an example trace id? I'll fetch pcaps.

claire: trc-euc-0311-b9f2. Logs show: 
```
2026-03-11T22:04:12Z svc-ingest -> proxy-eu handshake_start
2026-03-11T22:04:13Z svc-ingest -> proxy-eu handshake_wait 720ms
2026-03-11T22:04:13Z svc-ingest -> proxy-eu handshake_failure TLS alert 40
2026-03-11T22:04:13Z svc-ingest -> proxy-eu fallback_to_tcp
```

omar: Ran openssl against proxy-eu-02:443 - result: cert chain present but `OCSP response: no response sent`.

jin: We rotated intermediates at 22:00 with rotator v4. Rotator logs show a burst of KMS unwraps around 22:01 and some `rate_limit` warnings. ops-bot: any deploys?

ops-bot: deploy 2026.03.11-198 applied: rotator v4 and proxy image bump. No handshake timeout changes.

claire: Hypothesis: control-plane is delayed producing OCSP staples due to KMS unwrap throttling during rotation -> some ptls clients with short handshake timeout drop and fall back.

omar: Short-term: increase ptls client handshake timeout to 5s for proxies (hotfix) and re-run rotator in low-concurrency mode for eu-central. Also patch control-plane: if KMS unwrap fails, serve cached cert+staple until unwrap recovers.

jin: Agreed. Also add an alert rule: if OCSP stapling missing rate >0.5% in 10m post-rotation, auto-pause rotator.

claire: I'll open PR for timeout and the alert: https://git.internal/r/redwood/proxy/pulls/3330

omar: I'll coordinate a low-concurrency re-run and file support case with KMS provider for throttle mitigation.

jin: Postmortem items: rotation timestamp, KMS throttle timeline, percentage of ptls fallbacks, affected customer impact (count of 502s), and update rotation playbook with canary and KMS preflight unwrap check.

claire: Quick checklist:
- [ ] hotfix proxy handshake timeout -> 5s
- [ ] rerun rotator with concurrency=1 for eu-central
- [ ] KMS support escalation & retry/backoff tuning
- [ ] add rotation-canary and unwrap-smoke preflight

ops-bot: Incident labeled P1. Notifying compliance for SLO review.
